items.name: Lumine
items.description: Blonde female character wearing tactical gear, a headset, and a floral accessory, participating in a tactical exercise.
items.observation: Seen running, aiming a rifle, reloading Wriothesley's weapon, and later watching security footage in embarrassment.

related_events.relationship_description: Lumine appears aiming a rifle in a hallway corridor.
related_events.observation: Lumine holding and aiming an assault rifle.

related_events.relationship_description: Lumine interacts and converses with Wriothesley.
related_events.observation: Lumine talks and coordinates with Wriothesley.

related_events.relationship_description: Lumine assists Wriothesley by inserting a magazine into his rifle.
related_events.observation: Lumine handling magazine reload for Wriothesley.

related_events.relationship_description: Lumine looks surprised upon realizing they are on opposing teams.
related_events.observation: Facial reaction to Wriothesley discovering team conflict.

related_events.relationship_description: Lumine sits in the control room watching security footage.
related_events.observation: Lumine sitting and covering face in embarrassment.

items.name: Wriothesley
items.description: Dark-haired male character with tactical gear and a red armband.
items.observation: Appears in the hallway, receives reloading help from Lumine, realizes they are enemies, and watches footage in the control room.

related_events.relationship_description: Wriothesley steps into the hallway next to Lumine.
Wriothesley receives reload assistance from Lumine.
related_events.observation: Lumine inserts a magazine into Wriothesley's rifle.

related_events.observation: Wriothesley stops and inspects Lumine's patch.

related_events.relationship_description: Wriothesley sits in the control room watching the security footage.
related_events.observation: Wriothesley reacts embarrassedly while watching monitor.

related_events.observation: Keqing laughing near the control screen.
